title: Teaching an Arbitrary Ensemble, and a Code That Drifts

scenes.tts: If an odour is an ensemble of neurons, what happens if you make one without any odour?
scenes.visual: Title card: Teaching an Arbitrary Ensemble, and a Code That Drifts. A scatter of piriform cells, a few marked blue.
scenes.narration: If an odour is an ensemble of neurons, what happens if you make one without any odour?

scenes.tts: Choi and colleagues expressed channelrhodopsin in subsets of piriform neurons in awake mice.
scenes.visual: Label: Choi and colleagues, 2011. A sparse, arbitrarily chosen set of piriform cells in one region turns blue. Caption: an imposed ensemble, not a natural odour ensemble.
scenes.narration: Choi and colleagues expressed channelrhodopsin in subsets of piriform neurons in awake mice.

scenes.tts: Channelrhodopsin is a light-gated channel. Light drives those neurons, whatever the nose is doing.
scenes.visual: Light shines on the cortex; the blue cells fire. The nose icon is idle.
scenes.narration: Channelrhodopsin is a light-gated channel. Light drives those neurons, whatever the nose is doing.

scenes.tts: In one group, the light was paired with a reward. In another, with a shock.
scenes.visual: Two mice side by side: one with a water spout, one over a shock grid. The light flashes before each.
scenes.narration: In one group, the light was paired with a reward. In another, with a shock.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. What will each group learn? Would that show the mice smelled something?
scenes.visual: On screen: What will each group learn? Did they smell anything?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. What will each group learn? Would that show the mice smelled something?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: Paired with water, the light came to trigger licking. Paired with shock, it came to trigger flight.
scenes.visual: The reward mouse licks at the water spout when the light comes on; the shock mouse flees.
scenes.narration: Paired with water, the light came to trigger licking. Paired with shock, it came to trigger flight.

scenes.tts: Small ensembles were enough, though they gave a weaker response than larger ones.
scenes.visual: Fewer blue cells; the learned response arrow is thinner.
scenes.narration: Small ensembles were enough, though they gave a weaker response than larger ones.

scenes.tts: Mice could also learn to tell different activated groups of neurons apart.
scenes.visual: Two different blue scatters, labelled one and two, with different responses.
scenes.narration: Mice could also learn to tell different activated groups of neurons apart.

scenes.tts: So activity in these neurons is sufficient as a learned cue. Paired with an outcome, it was enough to learn an association.
scenes.visual: Label: sufficient as a learned cue, once paired with an outcome.
scenes.narration: So activity in these neurons is sufficient as a learned cue. Paired with an outcome, it was enough to learn an association.

scenes.tts: It does not show that the mice smelled anything. The authors withheld that claim.
scenes.visual: A thought bubble with an odour icon and a question mark. Caption: smell not established.
scenes.narration: It does not show that the mice smelled anything. The authors withheld that claim.

scenes.tts: Nor does it test where the association is stored, in piriform or in the areas it feeds.
scenes.visual: Arrows from piriform to downstream areas, each with a question mark.
scenes.narration: Nor does it test where the association is stored, in piriform or in the areas it feeds.

scenes.tts: Now the last puzzle. Does an odour's pattern stay put?
scenes.visual: A calendar strip of weeks.
scenes.narration: Now the last puzzle. Does an odour's pattern stay put?

scenes.tts: Schoonover and colleagues recorded single piriform neurons over days to weeks.
scenes.visual: Label: Schoonover and colleagues, 2021. Electrode traces stacked by day.
scenes.narration: Schoonover and colleagues recorded single piriform neurons over days to weeks.

scenes.tts: They used a decoder. It is a program trained to guess which odour was given, from the recorded activity.
scenes.visual: Activity patterns flow into a box labelled decoder, which outputs an odour name.
scenes.narration: They used a decoder. It is a program trained to guess which odour was given, from the recorded activity.

scenes.tts: Its score is compared with chance, the score of random guessing.
scenes.visual: A score axis with a dashed line labelled chance.
scenes.narration: Its score is compared with chance, the score of random guessing.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. Train the decoder on the first day. How well will it do a month later?
scenes.visual: A score curve starting high on day 1, with the rest of the axis blank. On screen: a month later?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. Train the decoder on the first day. How well will it do a month later?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: It approached chance. The odour responses had drifted.
scenes.visual: The curve falls across the weeks toward the chance line.
scenes.narration: It approached chance. The odour responses had drifted.

scenes.tts: Daily exposure to an odour slowed the drift.
scenes.visual: A second, slower-falling curve labelled daily exposure.
scenes.narration: Daily exposure to an odour slowed the drift.

scenes.tts: Drift does not mean the animal's smell changed. A decoder is a tool the experimenter holds.
scenes.visual: The decoder box sits outside the mouse, labelled experimenter's tool.
scenes.narration: Drift does not mean the animal's smell changed. A decoder is a tool the experimenter holds.

scenes.tts: A downstream circuit may read a moving population consistently.
scenes.visual: A downstream reader cell keeps giving the same output while the population pattern beneath it shifts.
scenes.narration: A downstream circuit may read a moving population consistently.

scenes.tts: If decoders retrained each day still work, the information is there, but the mapping changed. That reading needs checks that the same cells were tracked.
scenes.visual: Hypothetical, labelled if: daily decoders, one per day, each scoring high, beside the falling frozen decoder.
scenes.narration: If decoders retrained each day still work, the information is there, but the mapping changed. That reading needs checks that the same cells were tracked.

scenes.tts: So an odour does not always light the same set of cortical neurons, at least not in these recordings.
scenes.visual: The odour's ensemble drawn on day 1 and day 32; the lit cells differ.
scenes.narration: So an odour does not always light the same set of cortical neurons, at least not in these recordings.

scenes.tts: What stays stable on top of a moving code is still an open question.
scenes.visual: On screen: open question. What stays stable on top of a moving code?
scenes.narration: What stays stable on top of a moving code is still an open question.

scenes.tts: A scattered pattern can be taught meaning, and the pattern itself moves over weeks.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: taught meaning, moving pattern.
scenes.narration: A scattered pattern can be taught meaning, and the pattern itself moves over weeks.
